findings.title: Native offline unit selection omits the root package
findings.evidence: commands_for("all", "all") selects cmd/internal/shortcuts/extension/events/errs but never ".". Root package tests agent_content_embed_test.go, content_embed_affordance_test.go, lark_suite_assets_test.go and main_noauthsidecar_test.go are committed and not selected by the later E2E package commands.
findings.impact: The new Linux/macOS/Windows gate can pass without running portable root embedding and startup-guard regressions. The inherited Ubuntu coverage job does select root; this finding concerns completeness of the new native matrix, not total absence from CI.
findings.requested_change: Include the root package in all-offline unit selection and add a command-selection regression.

findings.title: Locale-default decoding breaks UTF-8 fixture output and selection evidence
findings.evidence: Exact ba2af28 run_command with locale.getencoding mocked to cp1252 returns mojibake for UTF-8 正文 and raises uncaught UnicodeDecodeError for UTF-8 不. Twenty committed inherited Go test source files also fail cp1252 decoding; selection_evidence uses Path.read_text() without encoding. Isolated environment neither preserves nor establishes Python UTF-8 configuration.
findings.impact: A non-UTF-8 Python 3.12 locale, relevant to the newly selected Windows runner, can corrupt test data or abort before the JSON report is written. This is a reproduced locale-condition bug; no claim is made that a native GitHub Windows run has been observed failing.
findings.requested_change: Establish deterministic UTF-8 for the runner and isolated Python children, and explicitly decode UTF-8 process/source/report content where needed. Test a non-UTF-8 parent locale and actual Unicode fixture output.

findings.title: Non-POSIX timeout leaves descendants holding output pipes
findings.evidence: With exact ba2af28 runner and only its os.name branch simulated as nt, a synthetic parent spawned a grandchild holding stdout/stderr for 0.7s. A 0.05s timeout returned after 0.742s: process.kill() terminated only the parent, then communicate() waited without a timeout for descendant-held pipes.
findings.impact: On the Windows branch, a stuck go-test or Python descendant can defeat the per-command deadline and prevent report publication until the outer CI job timeout. The simulation demonstrates the process/pipe failure mode on macOS; it is not native Windows cleanup evidence.
findings.requested_change: Use bounded native process-tree termination and pipe cleanup for Windows timeouts, with a descendant-holding-pipes regression and preserved timeout exit 124.

positive_findings: All four isolated gates are wired to every matrix OS, with fail-fast disabled and no continue-on-error. Actual nonzero command/step outcomes fail the gate; later stages and artifact upload use explicit always() conditions.
Checkout credentials are not persisted; workflow has read-only contents permission and no secrets or live selectors. Public Go dependencies are preloaded before suites disable downloads.

Runner allowlist replaces HOME/config/temp state, strips credential/test/loader settings, disables remote metadata/notifiers and Go saved environment/downloads. Four independently rerun focused tests verify credential stripping, loopback proxy targeting, nonzero child exit and separate skip/failure counts.

Inherited domain selection and omitted live tests are documented and included in reports. Platform skips retain reasons; documentation distinguishes workflow definition from a completed native execution.

Portability edits retain real CLI/customer-host builds and real local npm lifecycle. The native fake process replaces only the old shell-based test fixture; no real domain test is replaced by a canned success.

independent_execution.method: Replace reviewed module os binding only with SimpleNamespace(name="nt") on macOS, then run synthetic Python parent that starts a 0.7s sleeping grandchild with inherited pipes and sleeps itself. All processes finish within one second.

limitations: No broad unit/E2E suite, native GitHub workflow or remote/live request was run by this review. Native Linux, Windows and macOS CI success remain unverified until actual job artifacts exist.

The locale and non-POSIX timeout probes exercise exact committed runner logic with controlled inputs on Darwin arm64 / Python 3.14.6. Simulated conditions are labeled; they are not native Windows evidence.
Environment isolation is not an OS network sandbox. Shared dependency caches/tool locations and custom test transports remain an explicit boundary; no stronger guarantee is claimed.
The inherited Ubuntu coverage job includes root package tests; the new native offline matrix does not at the reviewed hash.

Seven focused tests pass despite the three findings. Static string checks cannot establish successful native execution. Nested Go/Python reports can contain parent/subtest events; counts are not a distinct business-capability count.

Later fixes, uncommitted source edits, live APIs, real model comparisons, held-out trials, signing and release acceptance are outside these reviewed hashes. Findings require separately hash-bound closure.
